items.title: Athleta × Valkyries co-branded team-store line
items.what: The first look at what a specialist apparel partner actually puts in a team store: product types, silhouettes, prices.
items.trigger: Product images, a drop date or a price list appear.

items.title: Monarch's next Dream collection
items.what: Whether the operator model produces a second distinct collection, and whether prices are ever published.
items.trigger: A second named Dream collection or a second WNBA team announcing Monarch.

items.title: Caitlin 1 apparel: price changes and restocks
items.what: Whether the $47–$325 apparel ladder holds, is discounted or sells out.
items.trigger: A price change on a monitored listing, or a markdown.

items.title: Refresh the fan-tee price baseline
items.what: The baseline is one day at one store. A second reading in January shows whether it moves.
items.trigger: Manual snapshot of the WNBA Store tee listings.

items.title: Liberty's first holiday / stocking-stuffer products
items.what: A direct test of the accessories and 12-month-calendar claims.
items.trigger: Holiday product announcement or a Barclays store renovation reveal.
items.where: Liberty team store; Modern Retail follow-ups

items.title: Coach beyond the bag charm
items.what: Whether the handbag partnership produces anything beyond one limited charm.
items.trigger: A second Coach × WNBA product on coach.com.

items.title: A second drop from NWSL × Dead Dirt
items.what: Whether a league-wide designer template is repeated, which separates a launch from a program.
items.trigger: A second release or a new designer template.

items.title: A Fever-specific fashion or retail-model announcement
items.what: No public Fever-level fashion partnership comparable to the Dream, Valkyries or Liberty examples was found. If one appears it is the most directly relevant new evidence.
items.trigger: Any announcement naming the Fever with a fashion, retail-operator or specialist partner.
items.where: Leads feed (below); Fever and WNBA newsrooms
